# function: entities_card

Returns a Lovelace `entities` card, for use in a dashboard `config`. Further card options, e.g. `title`, go in `options`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An entities card: each row is an entity ID or an entity row object.
locals {
  lights = provider::homeassistant::entities_card([
    "light.kitchen",
    { entity = "light.hall", name = "Hall" },
  ], { title = "Lights" })
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
entities_card(entities dynamic, options dynamic...) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `entities` (Dynamic) List of rows: each an entity ID, or an entity row object such as `{ entity = "light.kitchen", name = "Ceiling" }`.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Dynamic) At most one object of further keys to set on the result, e.g. `{ name = "Kitchen" }`. Keys with a null value are left out. It must not set a key that another argument already sets.
